name: Claude
tagline: AI that holds long documents and writes better code
description: Anthropic's assistant for long-document analysis, careful writing and programming, with projects, artifacts and a per-token plan for the team.
priceNote: Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Contract analysis, long-form review and software development
pros: The best behavior on the market for long documents, spreadsheets and contracts, without losing the thread
More measured and less pushy writing, which cuts human review time on corporate text
Large context window and strong coding performance, which favors technical work and repository analysis
Projects, artifacts and MCP connectors organize the work without forcing you to assemble tooling
cons: No native image generation and web search that is as mature as some competitors
The Pro plan caps usage in five-hour windows, which blocks intense work
The API bills per token and the cost of a long agent with a big context scales fast
The extension ecosystem is smaller than ChatGPT's, so ready-made content is scarcer

features.name: Long context
features.detail: Analyzes whole contracts, reports and repositories in the same conversation

features.name: Projects
features.detail: Groups conversations, files and instructions per client

features.name: Artifacts
features.detail: Side panel with the generated document, code and chart next to the conversation

features.name: Claude Code
features.detail: Terminal and IDE agent to edit and run code in a real repository

features.name: MCP connectors
features.detail: Connects internal tools through an open standard, with simple configuration

useCases: Analyze a supplier contract and flag risks, penalties and clauses that deviate from the standard
Rewrite standard supplier contracts in the language of the company
Review pull requests and write tests in the internal development repository
Analyze the consolidated quarterly financial report and list the questions for the controller
bestForWho: Companies with a legal, content or technology team that needs to read and produce long documents with rigor.
verdict: Claude is the assistant that makes the fewest mistakes in formal writing and the one that holds an entire document best, and that alone saves hours of review in legal, finance and technology. In return, it does not search the web with the depth of Gemini or Perplexity, so many research tasks still come out better in another tool. The Pro plan also caps usage in short windows, which caught us in the middle of a long contract analysis. For a small company, the Pro plan for each legal or content team member pays back within the first quarter. For a larger company, the Team plan or the API with your own governance makes more sense, because it gives you control over cost per token and a record of what was sent.
